thread:
Ellen (oncall): Observing a sudden surge of 429s across hosted-api starting ~09:07 UTC. Error rate ~18% for short window. Opening incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1950001111.
RateBot: Alert: api.rate_limit_429_count spike > 10% (service=hosted-api, region=us-east-1). Dash: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rate/hosted-429s?from=now-30m
Tom (infra-rate): Pushed a rate-limiter config change at 09:05 to move default window from 1s->60s to reduce throttling bursts. Looks like the new hysteresis logic mis-calculated tokens for short-lived bursts and aggressively rejected requests. Rolling the change back now.
Nina (support): We're seeing ~30 incoming tickets mentioning 429s, two paying customers reported failed jobs (BetaFin, Shoply). Adding them to priority list and sending mitigation notes.
Carlo (product): Oops, that change was meant for a feature flag experiment, shouldn't have hit default. We need to audit deployment gating.
Ellen (oncall): Mitigation: rollback applied at 09:12 UTC. Also temporarily increased quota for enterprise accounts while we validate. Please avoid redeploying rate-limiter configs until we validate gating.
SRE Bot: Post-rollback monitoring: 429 rate falling, back to baseline in us-east-1 by 09:18. Watching global drift.
Tom (infra-rate): Root cause preliminary: heap of tokens calculation used integer division in the new code path leading to floor-to-zero for short windows. Fix PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789. Will include unit tests for burst scenarios.
Nina (support): Sent targeted updates to BetaFin and Shoply, suggested retry/backoff and temporary increase applied. Logged support incident INC-2026-980 and linked tickets #2987, #2988.
Carlo (product): Action items: revert feature-flag rollout rules, add pre-prod canary and feature gate for rate config changes, and require pair-review for infra hotfixes that touch global defaults. Adding to incident page.
Ellen (oncall): Next steps: schedule a postmortem within 48h, include timeline, customer impact, and deployment policy changes. I'll attach the rollback logs and the PR to the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1950001111/postmortem.
StatusBot: Status update published to status.redwood.ai: "Intermittent 429 errors affecting Hosted API due to a rate-limiter config regression; service recovered after rollback. Investigating root cause and next steps."
Ellen (oncall): Marking incident mitigated for now. If you see any lingering 429 spikes or customer complaints, @here drop a note in this thread. :white_check_mark:
